name: Tatamiya Homura
source:
"What～? Were you actually eyeing up Homura～?"

Likes: Lying down and eating potato chips while watching television

A dragon girl who is a servant working for [url=/c125616]Eliska[/url]. She keeps a close watch on [url=/c125620]Shinra[/url] after he became the witch's servant. At the school, she is in the same class as him.

Like most servants, she even wears a maid's outfit during her private time, despite always having a sleepy-looking face and leading a slovenly life, she is also negligent​ and forces any hassle on Shinra. To a certain extent, she sees him as a troublesome younger brother, even though he is not her servant, she still thinks that she can use him as much as she wants.

On the other hand, since she is a dragon, she possesses an enormous strength, and in the event of an emergency, she becomes a very reliable person. 

To hide the fact from other people that she is a dragon, she uses magic to conceal her horns and tail (but Shinra can see them). In fact, her horns and tail appear to be her weak point, if one were to suddenly touch them......?

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/homura.html]official website[/url]]
